propositions: The test fixture's per-event oracle calls resolve_event_commit exactly once, but the batched resolver retries up to five times, causing the equivalence assertion to compare a recovered batched SHA against None when the one-shot oracle encounters a transient Git read failure.

Production resolve_event_commit deliberately maps all Git errors, empty results, timeouts, and exceptions to None and must remain fail-closed; changing it to retry transients would violate the documented contract and multiply cost for genuine no-match cases.

A test-local bounded helper _fixture_per_event_commit was added to retry the per-event oracle up to five identical attempts, returning only non-None SHAs and raising with object-store diagnostics on persistent failure, mirroring the established batched fixture recovery pattern.

All batched/per-event exact-equivalence assertions in the test module now route through the bounded helper, including the off-first-parent and ledger-parity cases, while production authorship code remains unchanged.
